meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把互相依赖的一批任务按阶段依次跑完,失败自动重试接管
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一堆有先后依赖的任务需要按顺序自动跑完
copy.tagline_en: Run a batch of dependency-ordered tasks phase by phase, retrying failures automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a set of tasks with dependencies must run automatically in order

howto.what: 在你提出有依赖顺序的多任务时,它把任务拆成带 dependsOn 的节点,按波次并行执行;一次运行只覆盖一个阶段,失败或改动的节点可单独重试、接管或修正,已完成节点的结果会被复用。
howto.when: 当你说出 “mass-ulw”、要求一个任务 DAG,或需要某些任务先等其它任务完成的扇出工作时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这批任务按依赖关系跑一遍。
say.note: 先读规划文档,再定义节点图

say.text: 把 rewrite 这个节点用新指令重试一次。
say.note: 只重跑该节点及其依赖节点

say.text: 给 lint 节点发消息:跳过 vendored 目录。
say.note: 运行中的子任务被就地纠偏

howto.what_en: When tasks have real dependencies, it splits them into nodes with dependsOn, runs them in parallel waves, with per-node recovery. One run covers a single phase; failed or edited nodes can be retried, steered, or amended, reusing done work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Run these tasks through mass-ulw in dependency order.
say_en.note: Reads the planning doc, then defines the graph

say_en.text: Retry the rewrite node with a new prompt.
say_en.note: Only that node and its dependents re-run

say_en.text: Send lint a message: skip the vendored directory.
say_en.note: Steers the running child in place
